structure DLWLean.FieldParameters : Type
number of parameters: 0
fields:
  DLWLean.FieldParameters.M : ℕ
  DLWLean.FieldParameters.M_ge_two : 2 ≤ self.M
  DLWLean.FieldParameters.Lx : ℝ
  DLWLean.FieldParameters.Lx_pos : 0 < self.Lx
  DLWLean.FieldParameters.h : ℝ
  DLWLean.FieldParameters.h_pos : 0 < self.h
  DLWLean.FieldParameters.c : ℝ
  DLWLean.FieldParameters.c_ne_zero : self.c ≠ 0
  DLWLean.FieldParameters.gamma : ℝ
constructor:
  DLWLean.FieldParameters.mk (M : ℕ) (M_ge_two : 2 ≤ M) (Lx : ℝ) (Lx_pos : 0 < Lx) (h : ℝ) (h_pos : 0 < h) (c : ℝ)
    (c_ne_zero : c ≠ 0) (gamma : ℝ) : FieldParameters
structure DLWLean.SmoothPeriodicField (M : ℕ) (Lx : ℝ) : Type
number of parameters: 2
fields:
  DLWLean.SmoothPeriodicField.value : Fin M → ℝ → ℝ
  DLWLean.SmoothPeriodicField.smooth : ∀ (j : Fin M), ContDiff ℝ ∞ (self.value j)
  DLWLean.SmoothPeriodicField.periodic : ∀ (j : Fin M), Function.Periodic (self.value j) Lx
constructor:
  DLWLean.SmoothPeriodicField.mk {M : ℕ} {Lx : ℝ} (value : Fin M → ℝ → ℝ)
    (smooth : ∀ (j : Fin M), ContDiff ℝ ∞ (value j)) (periodic : ∀ (j : Fin M), Function.Periodic (value j) Lx) :
    SmoothPeriodicField M Lx
structure DLWLean.PeriodicPhysicalState (par : FieldParameters) : Type
number of parameters: 1
fields:
  DLWLean.PeriodicPhysicalState.U : SmoothPeriodicField par.M par.Lx
  DLWLean.PeriodicPhysicalState.w : SmoothPeriodicField par.M par.Lx
  DLWLean.PeriodicPhysicalState.mean_w : ∀ (x : ℝ), (latticeMean fun j => self.w.value j x) = par.c
  DLWLean.PeriodicPhysicalState.mean_Uw : ∀ (x : ℝ),
      (latticeMean fun j => self.U.value j x * self.w.value j x) = par.gamma
constructor:
  DLWLean.PeriodicPhysicalState.mk {par : FieldParameters} (U w : SmoothPeriodicField par.M par.Lx)
    (mean_w : ∀ (x : ℝ), (latticeMean fun j => w.value j x) = par.c)
    (mean_Uw : ∀ (x : ℝ), (latticeMean fun j => U.value j x * w.value j x) = par.gamma) : PeriodicPhysicalState par
NotebookDLWConditions.fixedMeans (par : FieldParameters) (f : PeriodicPhysicalState par) (x : ℝ) :
  (latticeMean fun j => f.w.value j x) = par.c ∧ (latticeMean fun j => f.U.value j x * f.w.value j x) = par.gamma
